messages:
maya: starting canary publish for py/ts SDK now. release-bot shows a signing key mismatch on the python wheel, pausing rollout.

release-bot: publish job 9921 FAILED - signature key mismatch (expected 0xA1B2C3D4 got 0xFEEDFACE)

chris: pausing TS canary as well to avoid half-rollout. marking shiproom entry 'canary-paused'.

devops: ops rotated the CI signing key earlier today; sounds like CI didn't pick up new private key. will confirm key id used by runner.

maya: good call. if CI used old key we should republish rather than yanking existing artifacts.

chris: plan: 1) create npm dist-tag canary-fallback for current good TS 1.4.0 2) rebuild python with ops-confirmed key and publish as 1.4.1+sigfix 3) point canary to 1.4.1+sigfix after smoke tests.

devops: confirm: will validate runner key and re-trigger pipeline once fixed. expect 20-40m.

maya: smoke test to run on republish (example):
python -m venv /tmp/smoke && source /tmp/smoke/bin/activate
pip install redwood-sdk==1.4.1+sigfix --index-url https://test.pypi.org/simple
python -c "import redwood; print(redwood.__version__)"

chris: adding CI preflight to check GPG key id before signing (I'll open PR).

release-bot: publish job 9921 status = FAILED (manual intervention required).

maya: assigning owners: maya (coordinate republish), chris (CI gate + TS fallback), devops (confirm key and rerun). will update shiproom and ping support if anything user-visible pops up.
